# Generate a signing key.
ed25519-keygen
read privateKey
ed25519-pubkey $privateKey
read publicKey

# Record the realization for hello.txt.drv.
# We need it for the second realization.
[x86_64] [linux] storepath 9vx0ap4n2lpv5gxsb655vx6l4d92l65h-hello.txt.drv
[aarch64] [linux] fmw7jw6az4b9awgfyfnxwjdvgmysw9r5-hello.txt.drv
[aarch64] [macos] iig0kq9qmld6d20h1i9njvny879jb67h-hello.txt.drv
[x86_64] [windows] yf81wgl5mizi79sgz57x5qv6gypyv5cn-hello.txt.drv
read drv1Path
write-realization --sign=$privateKey $drv1Path!out jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt

# Record the second realization.
# The output references a derivation output and a source store object.
[x86_64] [linux] storepath j6f29s2w6phlmvsr5w5j7i9ch221ab2j-tworefs.txt.drv
read drv2Path
write-realization --sign=$privateKey $drv2Path!out cy53qwyvbbhj17x7rha8kqirjqnk9k97-tworefs.txt

# Realize the second derivation
# with a reuse policy that requires verifying the signature.
# It should come from the fallback.
realize --trust=$publicKey $drv2Path
realpath $out
read realOut
[verbose] ? cat $realOut
grep '^This is the fallback!$' $realOut

-- 9vx0ap4n2lpv5gxsb655vx6l4d92l65h-hello.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out", "", "r:sha256", "")],
  [],
  [],
  "x86_64-unknown-linux",
  "/bin/sh",
  ["-c","echo 'Hello, World!' > $out"],
  [
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- fmw7jw6az4b9awgfyfnxwjdvgmysw9r5-hello.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out","","r:sha256","")],
  [],
  [],
  "aarch64-linux",
  "/bin/sh",
  [
    "-c",
    "echo 'Hello, World!' > $out"
  ],
  [
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- iig0kq9qmld6d20h1i9njvny879jb67h-hello.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out","","r:sha256","")],
  [],
  [],
  "aarch64-apple-macos",
  "/bin/sh",
  [
    "-c",
    "echo 'Hello, World!' > $out"
  ],
  [
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- yf81wgl5mizi79sgz57x5qv6gypyv5cn-hello.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out","","r:sha256","")],
  [],
  [],
  "x86_64-pc-windows",
  "C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe",
  [
    "-Command",
    "Out-File -InputObject \"Hello, World!`n\" -NoNewline -Encoding ascii -FilePath ${env:out}"
  ],
  [
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- 9m3z0xd7dllq5j4rfmxr51b1zvka1qxk-file.txt --
This is a different file.
-- j6f29s2w6phlmvsr5w5j7i9ch221ab2j-tworefs.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out","","r:sha256","")],
  [
    ("/opt/zb/store/9vx0ap4n2lpv5gxsb655vx6l4d92l65h-hello.txt.drv", ["out"])
  ],
  [
    "/opt/zb/store/9m3z0xd7dllq5j4rfmxr51b1zvka1qxk-file.txt"
  ],
  "x86_64-linux",
  "/bin/sh",
  [
    "-c",
    "echo $in1 >> $out; echo $in2 >> $out"
  ],
  [
    ("in1", "/17qqgkj0ghr50cv5c3pif901fa6748nw4avgpwcr0gyzkmwjla6s"),
    ("in2", "/opt/zb/store/9m3z0xd7dllq5j4rfmxr51b1zvka1qxk-file.txt"),
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- [fallback] jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt --
Hello, World!
-- [fallback] cy53qwyvbbhj17x7rha8kqirjqnk9k97-tworefs.txt --
This is the fallback!
